summary: RenewCrewLease request, at start and then every minute, with the Crew's own credential, in the backend model's shape.

provisional.why: awsJson1_0 per the backend model. That the server routes on X-Amz-Target at POST / is pending the backend team, contract section 13 item 18.
Omitted after a start and after a 4401 or 4403 close, so the backend mints a host token. Pending the backend team, contract section 13 item 22.
How a team Crew's key or JWT-SVID becomes a bearer the backend accepts here is pending, contract section 13 item 21.

planPosition: crewVersion at most 32 characters, the Crew's own limit. The model sets none.
connectedCount counts the people connected now. The model says it is for display only.
caller: The Crew host, with the owner's Kiro sign-in for a personal Crew, or a team Crew's credential.

headers.TokenType: Matched case-sensitively. A team Crew sends its crew API key as the Bearer, as is, with TokenType API_KEY. A personal Crew sends its owner's sign-in: TokenType omitted for IAM Identity Center, AWS Builder ID and Kiro social sign-ins, and EXTERNAL_IDP for an Okta or Microsoft Entra ID sign-in. KIRO_MACHINE_TOKEN is refused on this operation. SSO_OIDC is not accepted. An unrecognized value counts as an omitted header and fails as a generic authentication failure. With the backend's Crew-for-Teams switch on, anything but API_KEY is refused today, a personal Crew included, pending contract section 13 item 29.

fields.crewInstanceId: Required. The lower-case UUID the Crew generated once.
fields.name: Required. The model's CrewName: 1 to 64 characters, ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 ._-]*$. A team Crew shows its administrator's name instead.
fields.relay: Required. connectionStatus, CONNECTED or NOT_CONNECTED, and endpointId once the Crew has one.
fields.connectedCount: Optional. 0 or more, the model's range. For display only.
fields.leaseVersion: Optional. The leaseVersion of the last answer. Omitted after a start and after a 4401 or 4403 close, which asks for a fresh host token.
